bullets: Added Gemini 4 Argon to the free model picker with a one-session-a-day limit and promotional pricing.
Removed the promotional badge for GLM 5.3 Flash now that its temporary pricing period has ended.
Removed the New badge from DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast and Muse Spark 1.3 model rows.
Moved DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast and GPT-6 Luna into the Optimized section of the model picker.
Paused Reddit ad engagements in the advertiser marketplace and disabled the bounties program globally.
Replaced the previous external app bridge with a new Integrations menu for connecting services directly.
Added a secure, masked credential entry form for account sign-in steps in sponsored tasks on the CLI.
Added a step progress indicator to the CLI for advertiser-funded tasks running in the terminal.
Updated the project understanding agent to use GPT-6 Luna instead of DeepSeek V4 Flash.
Updated data-use copy to clarify that user data may be shared for AI training and ad model selection.
Added a preflight check for sponsored tasks that stops execution if the OS is unsupported or tools are missing.
Improved error messaging for OpenRouter routing blocks when using bring-your-own-key setups.
Updated the free mode to prevent personal AI connection details from leaking into shared network requests.
